lab_meta <- list(id = "lab15", title = "Stationarity and Differencing")
lab_prompts <- c(
  q1 = "First difference ∇y_t equals:",
  q2 = "A slowly decaying ACF in levels often suggests:",

## What you will do

Open this file and click **Run Document**. Packages: `learnr`, `fpp3`.
Exercise chunks run when you click Run Code. They are not knitted in one pass.

## Levels vs growth
```{r diff-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=12}
library(fpp3)
spain <- global_economy |> filter(Country == "Spain")
spain |> autoplot(log(GDP))
spain |> mutate(g = difference(log(GDP))) |> autoplot(g)
spain |> ACF(log(GDP)) |> autoplot()
spain |> ACF(difference(log(GDP))) |> autoplot()
# Hand check:
difference(c(10, 12, 11, 15))
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("y_t - y_{t-1}", correct = TRUE),
  answer("y_t - y_{t-4}"),
  answer("y_t + y_{t-1}"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("Nonstationarity / strong persistence", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Exact white noise"),
  answer("You must set seasonality to none"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q3}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  open_answer(),
  placeholder = "Yes/No — ACF of differences …",
  trim = TRUE
)
```
